basic.name: Glistening Light
basic.description_template: Jing Yuan deals Lightning DMG equal to {{scaling1}}% of his ATK to a single enemy.

skill.name: Rifting Zenith
skill.description_template: Deals Lightning DMG equal to {{scaling1}}% of Jing Yuan's ATK to all enemies and increases Lightning-Lord's Hits Per Action by 2 for the next turn.

ultimate.name: Lightbringer
ultimate.description_template: Deals Lightning DMG equal to {{scaling1}}% of Jing Yuan's ATK to all enemies and increases Lightning-Lord's Hits Per Action by 3 for the next turn.

talent.name: Prana Extirpated
talent.description_template:
Summons Lightning-Lord at the start of the battle.
Lightning-Lord has 60 base SPD and 3 base Hits Per Action. When the Lightning-Lord takes action, its hits are considered as Follow-Up ATKs, with each hit dealing Lightning DMG equal to {{scaling1}}% of Jing Yuan's ATK to a random single enemy, and enemies adjacent to it also receive Lightning DMG equal to 25% of the DMG dealt to the primary target enemy.
The Lightning-Lord's Hits Per Action can reach a max of 10. Every time Lightning-Lord's Hits Per Action increases by 1, its SPD increases by 10. After the Lightning-Lord's action ends, its SPD and Hits Per Action return to their base values.
When Jing Yuan is knocked down, the Lightning-Lord will disappear.
When Jing Yuan is affected by Crowd Control debuff, the Lightning-Lord is unable to take action.

technique.name: Spiritus Invocation
technique.description: After the Technique is used, the Lightning-Lord's Hits Per Action in the first turn increases by 3 at the start of the next battle.

2.name: Battalia Crush
2.description: If the Lightning-Lord's Hits Per Action is greater or equal to 6 in the next turn, its CRIT DMG increases by 25% for the next turn.

4.name: Savant Providence
4.description: At the start of the battle, immediately regenerates 15 Energy.

6.name: War Marshal
6.description: After the Skill is used, the CRIT Rate increases by 10% for 2 turn(s).

eidolons.name: Slash, Seas Split
eidolons.description: When Lightning-Lord attacks, the DMG multiplier on enemies adjacent to the target enemy increases by an extra amount equal to 25% of the DMG multiplier against the primary target enemy.

eidolons.name: Swing, Skies Squashed
eidolons.description: After Lightning-Lord takes action, DMG dealt by Jing Yuan's Basic ATK, Skill, and Ultimate increases by 20%, lasting for 2 turn(s).

eidolons.name: Strike, Suns Subdued
eidolons.description:
Ultimate Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. 15.
Basic ATK Lv. +1, up to a maximum of Lv. 10.

eidolons.name: Spin, Stars Sieged
eidolons.description: For each hit performed by the Lightning-Lord when it takes action, Jing Yuan regenerates 2 Energy.

eidolons.name: Stride, Spoils Seized
eidolons.description:
Skill Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. 15.
Talent Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. 15.

eidolons.name: Sweep, Souls Slain
eidolons.description:
Each hit performed by the Lightning-Lord when it takes action will make the target enemy Vulnerable.
While Vulnerable, enemies receive 12% more DMG until the end of the Lightning-Lord's current turn, stacking up to 3 time(s).

affinitive_eidolon.name: One Quiet Cup of Thunder
affinitive_eidolon.description: The Max Hits Per Action for "Lightning-Lord" increases by 20. When Lightning-Lord's Hits Per Action reaches its upper limit, it immediately takes action. At the start of combat and after every 1 time(s) "Lightning-Lord" takes action, "Lightning-Lord" gets enhanced, and Jing Yuan's DMG dealt increases by 240%. When using Skill/Ultimate, additionally increases Lightning-Lord's Hits Per Action by 6/12 respectively, lasting for 4 turn(s).
